name: Ace Electronics
old_description: Since our inception in 1978, Ace Electronics has earned the position as the leading provider of state-of-the-art, customized cable assembly solutions. Our expertise encompasses multiple industries from Defense and General Industry to Robotics and Automation.
about:
Ace Electronics was founded in 1978 in Metuchen, New Jersey, and operates as a service‑disabled veteran‑owned small business (SDVOSB) with additional woman‑owned small business (WOSB) and small business (SB) designations. The company began as a provider of customized cable assembly solutions and has expanded to three U.S. locations: Metuchen, NJ; Aberdeen Proving Ground, MD; and Troy, MI.

The company functions as a contract manufacturer specializing in wire harnesses, custom cable assemblies, electro‑mechanical box builds, and injection‑molded components. Its engineering services support design through production, and all manufacturing personnel are certified to IPC/WHMA‑A‑620 standards. Facilities across the three sites hold distinct CAGE codes (7Y943, 5TWH2, 6BXZ9) and maintain ITAR registration for defense work.

Ace Electronics serves defense, aerospace, robotics/industrial, medical, and rail sectors. Prime contractors such as BAE Systems and Lockheed Martin have recognized the firm with Partner 2 Win Gold and Silver Tier awards and an Exceptional Small Business Award, respectively. The company also holds a position on the Missile Defense Agency’s SHIELD IDIQ contract vehicle with a $151 billion ceiling.

Leadership emphasizes a warfighter‑focused approach, citing longevity, certified staff, and a commitment to listening to client requirements as differentiators. The firm highlights its ability to deliver customized interconnect solutions across multiple vehicle platforms while maintaining ISO 9001:2015 quality management.
